label: Continuous logging (Sync Gateway)
type: Sync Gateway's per-level log file streaming (sg_error.log, sg_warn.log, sg_info.log, etc.), introduced in 2.1, and the mechanism sgcollect_info's own log collection relies on. Independent of console logging - changing console-logging settings does not affect the continuous-logging streams.
note: Sync Gateway needed its own sgw:-prefixed logging vocabulary (this concept, sgw:log-key, sgw:console-logging) rather than reusing the promoted log:log-file - confirming this round's own prediction that logging.md 'almost certainly needs its own sgw:-prefixed parallel rather than reuse.'
